newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST-Analysts see 2.5 pct y/y Danish Jan CPI.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-Analysts see 2.5 pct y/y Danish Jan CPI.

text.p: Analysts expected January's consumer price index (CPI), due at 0830 GMT on Friday, to rise an average 2.5-percent year-on-year, using the domestic method of calculation.

That would be up from December's 2.3-percent year-on-year rise. On a monthly basis, the fourteen Danish and international economists polled by Reuters on Wednesday expected January CPI to remain flat versus December. December CPI fell 0.1 percent from November.
Forecasts ranged between +2.2 and +2.7 percent for the annual figure and -0.2 and +0.2 for the monthly data.
There was no forecast using the European Union method of calculation.
